title: How Often Should a Small Business Send Emails in 2026

facts.fact: AdWave's general rule of thumb for how often a small business should send emails is 1-3 times per week.
facts.quote: the general rule of thumb is **1-3 times per week**

facts.fact: AdWave recommends that e-commerce brands send 3-7 emails per week with flash sales and new drops.
facts.quote: sending **3-7 emails per week** with flash sales and new drops can drive massive sales

facts.fact: AdWave states that B2B firms and local service providers often get better results sending 1-3 emails per week with high-value content.
facts.quote: sticking to that **1-3 email per week** range with high-value content

facts.fact: AdWave's article cites an unnamed study of over 2,000 adults finding that more than 60% of consumers appreciate weekly promotional emails from brands.
facts.quote: A study of over 2,000 adults found that more than **60% of consumers appreciate weekly promotional emails**

facts.fact: In the same unnamed study of over 2,000 adults cited by AdWave, 38% of respondents want to hear from brands even more often.
facts.quote: **38% want to hear from them even more often**

facts.fact: In the same unnamed study of over 2,000 adults cited by AdWave, 15% of respondents want messages every single day.
facts.quote: a full **15%** want messages every single day

facts.fact: AdWave says newsletters usually hit the right balance on a weekly or bi-weekly schedule.
facts.quote: A **weekly** or **bi-weekly** schedule usually hits the sweet spot.

facts.fact: AdWave states that transactional emails, such as order confirmations and password resets, must be sent immediately.
facts.quote: They are functional and must be sent **immediately**.

facts.fact: AdWave recommends that re-engagement campaigns for quiet subscribers be used sparingly, as a short focused series sent over a couple of weeks.
facts.quote: A short, focused series sent over a couple of weeks is a common strategy to win them back.

facts.fact: AdWave says the article's 1-3 emails per week figure is a starting point, not a one-size-fits-all solution, and that the right frequency depends on industry and audience expectations.
facts.quote: it’s definitely not a one-size-fits-all solution. The perfect frequency really depends on your industry
